description:
The Stinky Candle Company

Make money by selling the most unique smelling candles in the world

The Stinky Candle company was started by a couple of like-minded individuals who were tired of being sold the same old candle scents with different labels.  A decade later, The Stinky Candle Company has become one of the largest suppliers of uniquely scented candles in the world.  We have been featured in BuzzFeed, The Daily Mail, PopSugar, Thrillist, Motortrend, Metro, Perpetual Kid, The Awesomer, and were reviewed by Jeremy Clarkson from The Grand Tour.  We have fulfilled custom candle orders for major brands such as Pringles, Qdoba, and MLB.  And every day we bring both the sweet and sour scents of life to people all over the U.S.A.

Why Do Customers Choose Stinky Candle Company Products?

Accuracy

In a world where most candles just smell vaguely "nice", we put our money where our nose is.  Our candles always smell like what's on the label.  We work with scent suppliers all over the world to find, test, and approve only the most accurate scents to go into our candles.  Anything that's not up to snuff never makes it to market.

The result is a standard that we are known for.  Whether it's a Lilac Candle or a Body Odor Candle, you can be rest assured you will be smelling what you paid for.

Exclusivity

We are one of the largest producers of uniquely scented candles in the world for a very simple reason:  nobody else wants to make these things.  You think our Fart Candle smells bad?  Try making 200 of them at once.  We are committed to our mission to celebrate scents of all stripes, and make them readily available to the public.  And we stay committed to that mission, even if it means having to pour vomit-scented candles in our factory in the middle of a Texas July.

Thankfully for you, you don't need to deal with any of that unpleasantness - you just get to sell a truly unique product that customers will have a hard time finding anywhere else.

Peace of mind

As much as we focus on the accuracy of our candles, we understand that not everyone shares the same sense of smell.  We offer a 30 day, no-questions-asked return policy that guarantees a refund for any customer that is less than satisfied with their product.

We want our customers to rest easy knowing that they will never be required to pay for a product that they aren't happy with.  That's why they continue to trust us as their source for unique-smelling candles.

Safety

It's of the utmost importance that our products are safe for all our customers, which is why we ensure that not only are our products 100% safe, but they are organic as well.

100% USA Made

We have always manufactured our products entirely within the United States and will continue to do so.

Why Should You Sell Stinky Candle Company Products?

Competitive Commissions

We offer a generous commission rate on every sale you generate through your unique affiliate link.  We are also open to increasing commission rates for successful affilates, as well as exploring the creation of custom products for affiliates who are able to proven their sales abilities.

Endless Marketing Potential

We continue to be amazed by the response to (and uses for) our products.  From prank gifts to skunk scent lovers, we have witnessed over a decade's worth of customers finding ways to incorporate Stinky Candle Company products into their lives.

We actively encourage our marketers and affiliates to have fun and experiment with the best ways to advertise our extremely unique product line to potential customers.  Want to be the talk of the white elephant gift exchange this year?  Is there a special memory of a certain smell that you and your family share?  Maybe you just want to play a joke on the office and fill the break room with the scent of pee.  All of these ideas and more are possible through our products.

As long as your approach is relatively tasteful, we will applaud your success and eagerly reward your efforts to market in whatever creative ways appeal best to your audience.

Real-Time Tracking

See exactly where you're at with a user-friendly dashboard that gives you all the data you need on your sales, clicks, and commissions.

Access to High-Quality Marketing Assets

We share various branding and marketing assets with all our affiliates so they are set up for success.  Furthermore, we are always open to requests from our affiliates for specific assets if the situation calls for it.

Helpful & Encouraging Support Team

We do not employ any call centers and all affiliate requests and questions will be handled directly by a business owner.  We will do everything we can to furnish you with the tools you need to succeed.

Regular Payouts

We understand how frustrating it can be to work hard and not receive regular payouts.  We at the Stinky Candle Company commit to paying all our affiliates their commission via PayPal on a monthly basis.

Other Information

At this time, we are only able to ship our products to customers that reside within the United States.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to The Stinky Candle Company! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

 

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

 

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

5. Self-referrals

Please note that it is against the terms and conditions of the Stinky Candle Company affiliate program to use your affiliate link on purchases that you make for yourself.

If you feel like your affiliate marketing efforts would benefit from having samples of our products, please reach out to us at info@stinkycandlecompany.com.

 

6. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

 

7. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@stinkycandlecompany.com.

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@stinkycandlecompany.com for support.
